title: CWP/2050/2025 of M/S YK ENTERPRISES Vs UNION OF INDIA AND OTHERS
text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF PUNJAB AND HARYANA AT CHANDIGARH -.- Decided on 27.01.2025 M/s Y.K.Enterprises ....Petitioner VERSUS Union of India and Others ....Respondents CORAM : HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE ARUN PALLI HON’BLE MRS. JUSTICE SUDEEPTI SHARMA Present: Mr. Rishab Singla, Advocate for the petitioner. Mr. Sourabh Goel, Sr. Standing Counsel, with Ms. Geetika Sharma, Advocate, for respondent No.2 –CGST. -.- SUDEEPTI SHARMA, J. The challenge in the present writ petition is to the order dated 17.12.2024 passed by the Additional Commissioner (Appeals), Central GST Panchkula, Commissionerate, whereby the appeal filed by the petitioner was dismissed on the ground of delay.

2. Learned counsel for the petitioner contends that the impugned order dated 17.12.2024 is passed without giving any opportunity of being heard.

3. Per contra, learned counsel for respondent, on instructions from respondent No.2 i.e. the Additional Commissioner (Appeals), Central GST Panchkula, Commissionerate, states that a fresh order would be passed after hearing the petitioner.

4. We have heard learned counsel for the parties.

5. In view of the statement made by learned counsel for respondent, the order dated 17.12.2024 is set aside. The petitioner is directed to appear before the Appellate Authority on 06.02.2025. The Appellate Authority, thereafter, after hearing the petitioner would pass a fresh order in accordance with law, expeditiously, preferably within a period of six weeks from the date of receipt of copy of this order.

6. Disposed of accordingly.

7. Pending applications, if any, also stand disposed of. (ARUN PALLI) (SUDEEPTI SHARMA) JUDGE JUDGE January 27, 2025 tripti
